root_cause.statement: The resolved active organization is never validated against BlockingStatuses before the session is pinned to it. contact.organizationId / contact.organizations[0] is pinned by login while contact.organizations correctly filters blocked orgs out of the eligible list — so login pins the user to an org the same backend just excluded, and every org-scoped query then returns Forbidden.
root_cause.structural_note: VCST-5496 (Done, PR #308, released 3.1016.0) already fixed the LOCK variant of this in OrganizationIdRequestValidator. VCST-5281 extends the same accessible-org filter to STATUS but never propagated it into OrganizationIdClaimProvider, which re-resolves independently. #308's regression tests therefore never exercise the reopened path — a genuine structural coverage gap.
root_cause.retracted_hypothesis: An earlier synthesis blamed the storefront for omitting organization_id from the token grant. Wrong: the org-SWITCH grant does carry it (grant_type=refresh_token&organization_id=...). The defect is the unvalidated server-side default.
root_cause.fix_location: vc-module-customer — OrganizationIdClaimProvider + OrganizationIdRequestValidator; plus an L1 vc-frontend fix so the Organizations switcher renders on a /403 landing whenever me.contact.organizations.totalCount > 0

OrganizationIdClaimProvider.cs (+1/-22) and OrganizationIdRequestValidator.cs (+5/-62) both drop their own independent resolution and delegate to that single shared resolver.
candidate_p0_fix_pending_verification.why_it_matches_the_rca: This is precisely the fix QA's root cause prescribed: it closes the resolver ASYMMETRY (the claim provider re-resolving independently of the validator) that made VCST-5281 reopen the VCST-5496/PR-308 failure mode through a sibling mechanism. It also adds OrganizationIdClaimProviderTests.cs (+95) — the exact unit-test coverage gap the 08-03 test model flagged as unaddressed by #308.
